items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 65:1
items.html: All the aspects in Arich Anpin are divided into thirteen, being the three HaVaYaHs of the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK, in which there are twelve letters, and the aspect of the Malchut that includes the three HaVaYaHs, which has in it all twelve aspects of the twelve letters in the three HaVaYaHs. And the division of the hairs into the above thirteen aspects is called twelve strands of hair — that is, twelve groups of hairs — and a thirteenth strand that includes them all. (Page 365, Item 149).
